# Conxian Labs

> Conxian Labs provides Bitcoin-native infrastructure you can provision: a managed gateway, an enclave SDK, a non-custodial wallet, and verification nodes, with transparent pricing and a live status surface.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.conxian-labs.com/): Product overview and entry point.
- [Get Started](https://www.conxian-labs.com/get-started): Self-serve customer journey from sign-up to a running service.
- [Console](https://www.conxian-labs.com/console): Provision, manage, and cancel Conxian services.
- [Pricing](https://www.conxian-labs.com/pricing): Commercial packaging and plan matrix.
- [Status](https://www.conxian-labs.com/status): Live reachability of the public Conxian service surfaces.
- [Security](https://www.conxian-labs.com/security): Security posture and vulnerability disclosure.

## Machine-readable APIs

- Status: https://www.conxian-labs.com/api/status
- Services catalog: https://www.conxian-labs.com/api/services
- Site map: https://www.conxian-labs.com/api/site-map
- Health: https://www.conxian-labs.com/api/health
- Managed pricing: https://www.conxian-labs.com/api/pricing/managed

## Protocol surfaces

- Conxian protocol site: https://conxian.org/
- Gateway health: https://gateway.conxian.org/api/v1/health
- Nexus health: https://nexus.conxian.org/health
- BOS health: https://bos.conxian-labs.com/api/health

## Security

- [Security contact policy](https://www.conxian-labs.com/.well-known/security.txt): Coordinated vulnerability disclosure.
